definitions.pressure: Any standing defender center within 2 yd, from 0.5 s through the hold or sack. Attached rushers count.
definitions.stopped: Attached rusher speed <0.5 yd/s, sampled 0.25–0.75 s after first contact.
definitions.compression: Blocker displacement since first contact projected toward the original QB set point, at 2.5 s; surviving engagements only.
definitions.caveat: Forced holds isolate protection. No NFL target for these contact metrics. Samples at 2.5 s exclude plays already ended; consult sample counts.
